JANUS already contains multiple explicit epistemic defenses against fake verification, evidence-free certainty, branch erasure, echo inflation, translation escalation, correction orphaning, anti-paranoia failure and proof overreach.
DemiHead contains deterministic reference implementations for bounded epistemic execution and truth-guard behavior, with repository records of successful CI for declared scopes.

Its job is to constrain promotion: observations, calculations, external facts, associations, causal claims, mathematical claims, interpretations and high-impact conclusions must carry the evidence, provenance, replay, falsification, independence and claim-ceiling obligations appropriate to their class.
